facts.text: Product identity: Original – 3 Layered BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam Mattress – Grey.
Selected variant: Queen / 78 × 60 (198 × 152 cm); the page lists Queen and 78 × 60 as options.
Selected variant height: 6 in (15.2 cm); this height is listed as an option on the page.
The product is specified as a memory foam mattress.
The three-layer system has a soft foam top, a BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam layer, and a high-resilient foam base.
The product is described as medium firm.
The product is described as adapting to body shape, weight, and sleep position to provide personalized support.
The page claims pressure-point relief and proper spinal alignment; these clinical-style outcomes require separate substantiation.
